connector.name: CodeMap
connector.registryDescription: Roslyn-powered MCP server for C#/VB.NET. Query symbols, call graphs, and facts. 90%+ token savings.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the NuGet package codemap-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the bbajt account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: CODEMAP_CACHE_DIR
env.description: Path to a shared baseline cache directory. When set, index.ensure_baseline checks the cache before running a full Roslyn build — useful on CI or shared machines.
